# Template: navigation-js.md

Multi-page navigation helper template for `js/navigation.js`.
Replace `PAGES_ARRAY` and `NAV_GROUPS` placeholders.

---

```javascript
// Multi-page navigation — active state + breadcrumb helpers
// Generated by assembly-wiring. Edit PAGES and NAV_GROUPS when pages change.

const PAGES = [
  // PAGES_ARRAY — replace with actual pages:
  // { id: 'profiles-list', title: 'Profiles List', domain: 'profiles' },
  // { id: 'profile-detail', title: 'Profile Detail', domain: 'profiles' },
]

const NAV_GROUPS = {
  // NAV_GROUPS — replace with actual domain groups:
  // profiles: ['profiles-list', 'profile-detail'],
  // documents: ['documents-list', 'document-detail'],
}

// ── Active page detection ────────────────────────────────────────────
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const pathname = window.location.pathname
  const currentId = PAGES.find(p => pathname.endsWith(`/${p.id}.html`) || pathname.endsWith(`/${p.id}`))?.id

  if (currentId) {
    document.querySelectorAll(`[data-nav-id="${currentId}"]`).forEach(el => {
      el.classList.add('nav-item-active')
      el.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page')
    })
  }
})

// ── Helpers (available to inline Alpine expressions) ─────────────────
function getPageTitle(id) {
  return PAGES.find(p => p.id === id)?.title ?? id
}

function getPageDomain(id) {
  return PAGES.find(p => p.id === id)?.domain ?? ''
}

function getPagesInDomain(domain) {
  return PAGES.filter(p => p.domain === domain)
}
```

---

## Replacement guide for assembly-wiring

Replace `PAGES_ARRAY` with a JS array literal, one object per page:

```javascript
const PAGES = [
  { id: 'profiles-list',   title: 'Profiles List',   domain: 'profiles'  },
  { id: 'profile-detail',  title: 'Profile Detail',  domain: 'profiles'  },
  { id: 'documents-list',  title: 'Documents List',  domain: 'documents' },
  { id: 'document-detail', title: 'Document Detail', domain: 'documents' },
]
```

Replace `NAV_GROUPS` with a JS object literal, one array per domain:

```javascript
const NAV_GROUPS = {
  profiles:  ['profiles-list', 'profile-detail'],
  documents: ['documents-list', 'document-detail'],
}
```

The order of domains in `NAV_GROUPS` determines the visual order in the sidebar nav.
The order of IDs within each domain array determines page order within the group.
